name: Íllar (Spain)
description: Vertically divided yellow and blue in the proportions 1:1, charged on the yellow with the crowned municipal arms of Íllar (a bend on blue and a tree with a deer on red).
history: Municipal flag of Íllar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Íllar arms — bend, tree and deer
